edges.assessment: Surviving retrieval branch. Chime's index supplies distinct standard-agreement destinations. SoLo's index distinguishes current Bangor documents from archived terms and service-provider documents.
Collapsible. An all-institution FDIC dataset can be downloaded before knowing the bank names, then joined locally. This candidate does not count this edge as necessary sequential retrieval.

fixed_download_assessment.official_archive: The archive's documented scope is same-domain CFPB HTML. It does not archive the off-domain company agreements or their bodies. Inspected action summaries do not supply the selected 2026 agreement revision labels and issuer relationships.
fixed_download_assessment.fdic: Documented institution bulk/API scope supplies bank identity and institutional attributes. The actual default response contains bank names and certificates. It does not supply the examined fintech agreement bodies or their revision labels. A full institution file is credited as resolving all bank-name-to-certificate joins.
fixed_download_assessment.limits: No complete FDIC bulk file or complete definition schema was obtained. The surviving-edge assessment relies on the official dataset/collection scopes and actual company-source discoveries, not on failed requests or a claim that every possible public archive was searched.
fixed_download_assessment.reference_inputs: The finite evidence files assembled after discovery are reproducibility inputs. Their existence after construction is not asserted to prove retrieval dependency. The claimed dependency occurs while discovering those company documents from the cohort.
